newsitem.title: ZAIRE: U.S. envoy visits Mobutu for Zaire crisis talks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoy visits Mobutu for Zaire crisis talks.

text.p: U.S. troubleshooter Bill Richardson, in Zaire seeking a negotiated end to the civil war, went into President Mobutu Sese Seko's Camp Tshatshi residence on Tuesday for talks on the crisis, witnesses said.

Diplomats said Richardson, who is also anxious to ease the plight of dying Rwandan Hutu refugees in rebel-held areas, was expected to leave for the southern mining capital of Lubumbashi later in the day and talks with rebel leader Laurent Kabila.
